title: tc-delegate-board
description: Hand work to agents by dragging it onto them – or by click and keyboard.

agents.description: The agents work can go to, in the order they're listed (number keys 1–9 pick them)

tasks.description: Every task – without an `agentId` it waits under "Unassigned"; the first in each agent's queue is the running one

now.description: The clock for the "Busy until" times, in epoch ms – without it the board reads the clock while connected

mode.description: Auto hands every unassigned task to the least busy agent on its own; Manual waits for a drag. Changed by the user unless a tc-mode-change listener calls preventDefault()

suggestion.description: A suggested hand-off, e.g. from your router: the agent lights up and previews the new time, the task is marked

model.description: Model or role, shown under the name

avatar.description: A small mark, e.g. the model maker's logo (an element, cloned, or text) – defaults to the initials

current.description: Minutes left on the task it is running now (the first task in its queue), for the "Busy until" time

rate.description: What a minute of its work costs (e.g. 0.05 for $0.05) – shows the price per task when you hand one over

tools.description: Small logos of the tools it works in (elements, cloned) – up to three

agentId.description: Who it is with – leave it out for unassigned. In each queue, the first task is the running one
